newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar jumps to 1.8455 marks, highest since Nov 89.
newsitem.headline: Dollar jumps to 1.8455 marks, highest since Nov 89.

text.p: The dollar jumped to 1.8455 marks in mid-morning Tokyo trade on Monday, traders said, its highest level since November 1989, when the U.S. currency reached a peak of 1.8690/95 marks. The dollar's gains were due in part to sales of marks for yen, they added.
Stop-loss buying was detected above 1.84 marks, accelerating the dollar's upward swing.
Dealers cited the dollar's upward trend against the yen this morning as another factor pushing up dollar/mark.
The dollar had traded at 1.8382/84 marks at 2400 GMT, compared with 1.8368/78 marks in New York on Friday.
